integrity: The graph is independently reconstructed from projective incidence. A rank-13 symmetric graph-pattern matrix proves M at least 13, the standard M<=Z inequality gives Z at least 13, and an explicit 13-vertex chronological forcing sequence gives equality. The complete polynomial checks all 2^26 subsets, and the symmetry census uses a verified order-5616 projective group action.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the 26-vertex intersection graph of nonzero proper subspaces of F_3^3.
The orbit decomposition is for the natural PGL(3,3) action and does not assert that this is the full graph automorphism group.
The full polynomial and orbit decomposition use exhaustive finite enumeration; the minimum-size equality additionally has a symbolic rank proof and explicit forcing witness.
An earlier 2012 journal article on the graph family was found with month-level issue evidence but without a verified exact first-public day, so no publication day is invented from it.
title: Exact zero forcing census for the intersection graph of three-dimensional ternary space
